name: Masala Dhokla with Extra Chana Dal
ingredients: ½ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt
steps: Whisk besan, chana dal flour, soy yogurt, ginger-chilli paste and water into a smooth thick batter.
Rest 5 minutes while bringing steamer water to a steady boil. Grease a shallow steaming tray.
Just before steaming, fold fruit salt into batter with one quick motion; transfer immediately to tray.
Steam covered 12–15 minutes until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Heat oil; crackle mustard seeds and curry leaves, add a splash of water and lemon, then spoon over dhokla. Cool slightly and cut.
note: Vegan adaptation using soy yogurt; verify fruit salt ingredients. Steam time depends on tray depth.
